Standard_CStringHasher is the unit struct CStringHasher, which also implements ncollection::HashPolicy for any AsRef<[u8]> key. A C string is a byte slice read up to its first NUL, as strlen/strcmp read it. Strings shorter than 4 bytes hash with FNV-1a, longer ones with hashBytes, as natively.

api.upstream_id: Standard_CStringHasher::operator()(const char* const,const char* const) const

The templates hash the object representation (&theValue, theLen bytes); the port takes `&[T]` with T: bytemuck::NoUninit (types without padding, so the byte view equals the C++ one) and panics when the length exceeds the object, where C++ would read out of bounds. The template result type T is the HashWord parameter (u32, u64, usize): an 8-byte word selects the 64-bit engine, any other width the 32-bit one, as the two enable_if overloads do; one row covers both. The C++ defaults (sizeof(T1), optimalSeed) are explicit arguments.
